scripts.name: Python点集排序
scripts.source:
# coding: utf-8
from ioHelper import *

def Process(data) -> int:
    moduleVar = IoHelper(data, INIT_MODULE_VAR)
    globalVar = IoHelper(data, INIT_GLOBAL_VAR)
    localVar = IoHelper(data, INIT_LOCAL_VAR)
    try:
        xs = list(moduleVar.InX or [])
        ys = list(moduleVar.InY or [])
        count = min(len(xs), len(ys))
        order = sorted(range(count), key=lambda index: (float(xs[index]), float(ys[index])))
        moduleVar.OutX = [float(xs[index]) for index in order]
        moduleVar.OutY = [float(ys[index]) for index in order]
        moduleVar.OriginalIndex = [int(index) for index in order]
        moduleVar.PointCount = int(count)
    except BaseException as error:
        PrintMsg(error)
        return -1
    return 0
